jobs.title: Social Worker School
jobs.description:
**About Us**


TheraPeds Partners is a Colorado based, therapist\-owned and operated organization. We partner with our local schools to provide **School Social Worker (SW)** services to PreK–12 students nationwide. As a team of special education providers, we understand the education process, IDEA requirements, and the importance of collaboration within multidisciplinary teams. Our mission is to deliver high\-quality **School Social Worker (SW)** services while making meaningful connections in a collaborative learning environment.

**Job Description and Responsibilities**


This is a full\-time or part\-time, on\-site role as a **School Social Worker** serving a school located in **Littleton (Jeffco), CO.**


The **School Social Worker (SW)** will be responsible for providing therapy services to students, conducting assessments, developing IEP plans, evaluating and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams (therapists, educators, parents), supporting students according to their IEP. The role requires strong communication and interpersonal skills, as well as a passion for working with students with special needs.

**Job Details**

* Full Time, 37\.5 hours/week
* This is a full\-time or part\-time position
* 2026\-2027 School year, August \- May/June.
* Elementary grades
* Job Duties: evaluations, consultation, eligibility and diagnostics, student services
* Guaranteed Hours, including documentation, administrative and planning time
* On\-site, in person
* Dual support from the District and TheraPeds
* Manageable caseloads
* $50 \- $70\+/hour ($1875 \-$2625week\+)

  

**Requirements** **Qualifications**

* **Master’s degree in Social Work (MSW)** (LSW) or LCSW) from an accredited program
* **Colorado Department of Education (CDE) Special Services Provider (SSP) License** with **School Social Worker endorsement** (or eligibility)
* Completion of **900 hours of supervised practicum/fieldwork** in social work settings
* Experience working with **children or school\-aged students** preferred
* Knowledge of **IEPs, special education law, and behavior intervention planning**
* 2\+ years of experience (preferred but not required)
* Organizational and time management skills
* Proficient in use of technology
* Fingerprint background clearance

**Physical Requirements**


Working and playing with students requires that employees must be able to perform the necessary physical movement functions, as needed, such as lifting, sitting, walking, standing, crawling, and engaging with students in all physical locations and activities, **while adhering to the duties outlined by the district.**

 **Benefits** **Benefits (eligibility dependent on employment status)**

* Competitive compensation package with benefits including health, dental, and vision and 401K (W2\)
* Resources for health benefit enrollment and hourly rates which includes a stipend for health benefits and taxes (1099\)
* Opportunities for professional development and continuing education
* Access to a supportive network within the TheraPeds community
* Guaranteed hours
* Bi\-monthly salary deposits
* This position will be a W\-2 employee or a 1099 contractor

**Summary**


TheraPeds Partners is seeking a full\-time or part\-time, on\-site **School Social Worker** for a school\-based position in **Littleton (Jeffco), CO.** This role is ideal for candidates searching for **school social worker** jobs near me or full\-time Colorado school social worker positions

jobs.title: Home Health Medical Social Worker
jobs.description:
**About us**

We currently have needs for a Per Diem Home Health Medical Social Worker in Denver and surronding counties.

What sets us apart from other agencies? While many agencies are corporate\-run, we pride ourselves on being a local\-owned, boutique\-style company that provides exceptional care to those we have the honor of working with. Our leadership team is comprised of clinicians serving clinicians.

In addition to the below benefits, we offer a strongly competitive wage, a multi\-discipline collaborative team**,** very reasonable case load expectations, and a **fun** team environment**.** Our team enjoys working together and playing together. Examples of team activities range from snowshoe hiking, ax\-throwing, happy hours, and costume contests and picnics.

Although this position is Monday through Friday from 8:30 \- 5pm, our MSW role is autonomous with built in flexibility based on your patients’ needs. We believe a work/life balance is not only important for the lives of our team members but allows us to show up with the best care possible to those we serve.

Whether you are an experienced MSW or new to the idea of providing skilled care in the home setting, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

* Assesses the psychosocial status of patients and families/caregivers related to the patient's terminal illness and environment and communicates findings to the registered nurse and other members of the interdisciplinary group. Provides an assessment in the patient's identified residence and assistance when this is not safe and another plan is required.
* Carries out social evaluations and plans intervention based on evaluation findings. Counsels patient and family/caregivers as needed in relationship to stress, and other identified coping difficulties.
* Maintains clinical records on all patients referred to social work.
* Provides information and referral services for organization patients and families/caregivers regarding practical and environmental needs.
* Provides information to patients and families/caregivers and community agencies.
* Serves as liaison between patients and families/caregivers and community agencies.
* Maintains collaborative relationships with organization personnel to support patient care.
* Maintains and develops contracts with public and private agencies as resources for patient and personnel.
* Participates in the development of the individualized plan of care and attends regularly scheduled interdisciplinary group meetings.
* Assists physician and other team members in understanding significant social and emotional factors related to health problems and death/dying issues.
* Actively participates in quality assessment performance improvement teams and activities.
* Other duties as delegated by the Clinical Supervisor/Nursing Supervisor

Skills:

* Mus have a Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) from a school accredited by the Council on Social Work education.
* Minimum of one year's experience in health care, Home Health experience is preferred but understands hospice philosophy, and issues of death/dying.
* Demonstrates good verbal and written communication, and organization skills.
* Possesses and maintains current CPR Certification.
* Prolonged or considerable walking or standing. Able to lift supplies and equipment. Considerable reaching, stooping, bending, and/or crouching. Visual acuity and hearing to perform required MSW skills.
* Must be a licensed driver with an automobile that is insured in accordance with state/or organization requirements and is in good working order.

Note: This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. The employee may be required to perform other duties as assigned by their supervisor.

If you are a compassionate and dedicated Medical Social Worker looking for an opportunity to make a difference in patients' lives, we encourage you to apply.

Job Type: Part\-time

Pay: $35\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

License/Certification:

* BLS Certification (Required)
* Licensed Clinical Social Worker (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Denver, CO (Required)

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Certified Peer Support Specialist – Community Outreach
jobs.description:
Certified Peer Support Specialist – Community Outreach

**New Leaf Peer Support LLC** is seeking a motivated and compassionate **Certified Peer Support Specialist** to join our growing behavioral health team in the Denver Metro area.

This position is primarily focused on **community outreach, engagement, and peer support services** for individuals experiencing mental health challenges, substance use disorders, homelessness, justice involvement, or housing instability.

Responsibilities

* Conduct outreach in the community, including shelters, hospitals, treatment centers, probation/parole offices, and other referral sources.
* Build relationships with community organizations and referral partners.
* Identify and engage individuals who could benefit from behavioral health and recovery services.
* Assist with client recruitment and referrals into our programs.
* Provide one\-on\-one peer support services using your lived experience and recovery journey.
* Facilitate peer support groups as assigned.
* Assist clients with accessing housing, Medicaid, employment, transportation, and community resources.
* Complete documentation in a timely and accurate manner.
* Work closely with our clinical and case management teams to support client success.

Qualifications

* **Current Colorado Certified Peer Support Specialist (CPSS) certification is required.**
* Minimum of **1 year of peer support or behavioral health experience preferred.**
* Outreach, community engagement, or street outreach experience strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage daily outreach activities.
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel throughout the Denver Metro area.
* Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, mental illness, or substance use disorders is highly preferred

Preferred Qualifications

* Existing relationships with referral agencies, shelters, hospitals, or community organizations.
* Ability to bring referrals or assist in growing the client census.
* Knowledge of Colorado Medicaid behavioral health services and community resources.

What We Offer

* Competitive pay based on experience.
* Opportunity for advancement within a growing organization.
* Supportive team environment.
* Meaningful work helping individuals achieve recovery, stability, and independence.

If you are passionate about helping others and enjoy working in the community to connect individuals with life\-changing services, we encourage you to apply.

Pay: $21\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
